The '''Velga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Velga Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Velga system sat at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] and the [[Velga Route]]. The Senex-Juvex Loop connected it to the [[Loovria system/Legends|Loovria]] and [[Pieldi system/Legends|Pieldi systems]], while the Velga Route connected it to the [[Q'mara system/Legends|Q'mara system]].<ref name="TEA" />
